name: x-reply-ai-index
description: >-
  When the user wants an estimate of which replies under an X (Twitter) post
  look AI-generated ("X 评论区 AI 指数"), scored by you with the bundled detection

---
# X 评论区 AI 指数

Scoring is done by you (the agent's own model). No user API key is needed or used.

1. Collect the parent post and its replies as JSON: {parent:{id,text}, replies:[{id,handle,text,delaySeconds}]} from what the user pastes or X read tools.
2. Build the SYSTEM and USER prompts from the upstream x-reply-guard detection prompt (MIT, @dontbesilent), used verbatim.
3. Follow the SYSTEM prompt and score the replies yourself as {results:[{id,score,signals,reason}]}. Score at most 20 replies per batch and reuse earlier results for any reply id already scored (cache by tweet id).
4. Report each reply as `AI 估计 <score>` with signals and reason. Always say these are estimates that may be wrong; never use shaming labels.
5. Hide/block: never automatically, in batch, or by threshold. Only if the user names ONE specific reply and asks, restate it and get explicit confirmation before acting on that single reply.

Attribution: dontbesilent2025/x-reply-guard, MIT license.
